title: The Aiguilles Lighthouse
flavorText: Force 9 gale: five people stuck in the tower, and the head keeper no longer writing up his watch log.
intro: The supply launch could not leave, and neither could the lighthouse inspection: there were five of them in the tower that night. At the six o’clock reading the lantern was still turning, but Gaspard Quéré was no longer keeping his watch log.
